description: Implementation of USB device management including device enumeration, hotplug event handling, driver binding/unbinding, and device information retrieval within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBDeviceImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing USB device enumeration, hotplug events, driver binding, and device info retrieval within the plugin.

methods.name: libUSBInit
methods.description: Initializes libusb context, registers hotplug callbacks, and starts event handling thread.

methods.name: libUSBClose
methods.description: Cleans up libusb resources, deregisters callbacks, and stops event thread.

methods.name: libUSBEventsHandlingThread
methods.description: Thread function to handle libusb events.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceAttached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is attached; dispatches device arrival event.

methods.name: libUSBHotPlugCallbackDeviceDetached
methods.description: Callback invoked when a USB device is detached; dispatches device removal event.

methods.name: getDeviceSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves serial number of a USB device via sysfs.

methods.name: getDevicePathFromDevice
methods.description: Determines device path by matching serial number and device info.

methods.name: getUSBDescriptorValue
methods.description: Fetches string descriptor from device handle for a given language ID and index.

methods.name: getUSBExtInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves extended device info including manufacturer, product, serial number, and language IDs.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceInfoStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Populates device info structure from device descriptor and configuration.

methods.name: getUSBDevicClassFromInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Determines device class/subclass from interface descriptors.

methods.name: getUSBDeviceStructFromDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Fills USB device structure with basic info from device descriptor.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for device events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches device events to registered notifications.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Invokes callback methods for device plugged in/out events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected USB devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed info for a specific device by name.

methods.name: BindDriver
methods.description: Binds kernel driver to a device.

methods.name: UnbindDriver
methods.description: Detaches kernel driver from a device.
